name: Cube
description: The cube is a platonic solid with 6 square faces. It is the basis of the universal 3-dimensional cartesian coordinate system. It can be constructed by extruding a square into 3D by the right amount or taking the dual of an octahedron
trivia: The cube is an extremely widespread way to tile the plane and is widely used in voxel-based computer simulations
The cube is used as the most common type of game die (D6)
